+# Design: organization_id in session responses
+
+Date: 2026-06-05
+Reference implementation: [auth-util-lambda PR #47](https://github.com/sitoo/auth-util-lambda/pull/47)
+
+## Goal
+
+`POST /accounts/{account_id}/sessions` and `POST /accounts/{account_id}/support-sessions` responses include `organization_id` of the account logged into. Resolved against accounts-mono entity-management. No caching (unlike auth-util-lambda).
+
+## Decisions
+
+| Decision | Choice |
+|---|---|
+| Failure semantics | Lookup failure or missing mapping → login fails with 500. Error logged with tag, caught by CloudWatch alarm. |
+| Schema | `organization_id` required, readOnly, string format uuid (uuidv7) in `Session` + `SupportSession` |
+| Identity | New HMAC identity `auth` registered in entity-management (not shared with auth-util-lambda) |
+| Code reuse | Copy `client.go` + `hmac.go` from auth-util-lambda into this repo. No shared lib. |
+| Caching | None. Direct lookup per session create. |
+| Local dev | secrets.env points at test entity-management with real secret |
+
+## Components
+
+### 1. API schema (`api/openapi.yaml`)
+
+- Add `organization_id` to `Session` and `SupportSession` schemas:
+  - `type: string`, `format: uuid`, `readOnly: true`
+  - Added to `required` list of both schemas
+- Run `make generate` to regenerate handler/service/model code.
+
+### 2. Entity-management client (`provider/entitymgmt/`)
+
+Copied from `auth-util-lambda/entitymgmt/` (`client.go`, `hmac.go` + tests), with changes:
+
+- Identity `auth` instead of `auth-util-lambda` in the Basic auth credential
+- Accepts injected `*http.Client` instead of constructing its own (enables `staticTripper` stubbing in integration tests; timeout set on injected client, 2s)
+- `resolver.go` (cache) NOT copied — no caching
+
+Behavior kept from reference:
+
+- `GET {base_url}/organizations?account_id={id}`
+- Auth header: `Basic base64("auth:" + hmacHex + "-" + timestampMillis)` where
+  `hmacHex = HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp || method || url || body)`
+- 2 attempts total; retry on network error or 5xx; 404 → not found (no error, no retry); other 4xx → error, no retry
+- 1 MiB response body limit
+
+### 3. Service layer (`service/session.go`)
+
+- `Session` struct and `NewSession` gain an `orgClient` dependency behind a small interface:
+  ```go
+  type orgResolver interface {
+      GetOrganizationByAccount(ctx context.Context, accountID int64) (orgID string, found bool, err error)
+  }
+  ```
+- Lookup performed in `createSession` (single shared path — covers both `/sessions` and `/support-sessions`), placed **before** `mysql.AddSession` so failed logins leave no orphan session rows.
+- On lookup error or `found == false`: return `errors.CodeInternalServerError` (→ HTTP 500) and log at error level with `String("tag", errDataTagEntityMgmt)` where `errDataTagEntityMgmt = "entity_mgmt_error"` (same pattern as `errDataTagOIDCProvider`).
+- `genmodel.Session` response gains `OrganizationId`; `AddSupportSession` copies it into the `SupportSession` response.
+
+### 4. Bootstrap + config
+
+- `app/constants.go`: `ConfigEntityMgmtBaseURL` (`ENTITY_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL`), `ConfigEntityMgmtSecretARN` (`ENTITY_MANAGEMENT_AUTH_SECRET_ARN`)
+- New `readEntityMgmtSecret()` in `bootstrap/init_secrets_manager.go` following existing pattern: dev mode uses env value directly, otherwise Secrets Manager `GetSecretValue`
+- Wire client into `NewSession` at bootstrap
+
+### 5. Terraform (`infra/`)
+
+- Variables: `entity_mgmt_base_url`, `entity_mgmt_secret_arn`, `entity_mgmt_secret_kms_key_arn`
+- Lambda env vars: `ENTITY_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL`, `ENTITY_MANAGEMENT_AUTH_SECRET_ARN`
+- IAM policy on lambda execution role: `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` on secret ARN, `kms:Decrypt` + `kms:DescribeKey` on KMS key ARN (mirror auth-util-lambda `infra/iam.tf`)
+- New alarm in `infra/alarms.tf` using `alarms/log_filter` module, filter `{ $.tag = entity_mgmt_error }`, mirroring the `oidc_provider_error` alarm shape but `alarm_threshold = 0` (these failures block logins — alert on any sustained occurrence)
+- `infra/env/test`: real values (test entity-management URL `https://entity-management.sitooapis-test.com/v1/`, ARNs from accounts-mono once provisioned)
+- `infra/env/prod`: placeholder until accounts-mono prod provisioning done
+- Outbound HTTPS from VPC lambda already works (OIDC token calls) — no networking change
+
+### 6. Cross-account coordination (accounts-mono team, gates merge)
+
+Same checklist as auth-util-lambda PR #47:
+
+1. Secrets Manager secret (HMAC shared secret) encrypted with CMK in accounts-mono account
+2. KMS key policy grants auth lambda execution role `kms:Decrypt` + `kms:DescribeKey`
+3. Secret resource policy grants the role `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue`
+4. Register identity `auth` in entity-management mapped to this secret
+5. Publish secret ARN + KMS key ARN (test + prod)
+
+### 7. Tests
+
+- Unit: port `hmac_test.go` + `client_test.go` from auth-util-lambda (adjust for injected http.Client and identity `auth`)
+- Integration (`integrationtest/session_test.go`):
+  - Stub entity-management response via existing `staticTripper`
+  - Assert `organization_id` present in `POST /sessions` and `POST /support-sessions` responses
+  - Failure case: entity-management error → login returns 500

+package entitymgmt

+import (
+	"crypto/hmac"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+)
+
+// calculateRequestHmac mirrors the TS implementation in
+// accounts-mono/services/entity-management/src/utils/hmac.ts.
+// HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp || method || url || body.
+func calculateRequestHmac(secret, timestamp, method, url, body string) string {
+	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
+	mac.Write([]byte(timestamp))
+	mac.Write([]byte(method))
+	mac.Write([]byte(url))
+	mac.Write([]byte(body))
+	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
+}

+		http:    httpClient,

+// GetOrganizationByAccount resolves a Sitoo account_id to its organization_id.
+// Returns (orgID, true, nil) on success, ("", false, nil) when no mapping exists,
+// ("", false, err) on transport / decoding failures.
+func (c *Client) GetOrganizationByAccount(ctx context.Context, accountID int64) (string, bool, error) {
+	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/organizations?%s",
+		c.baseURL,
+		url.Values{"account_id": []string{strconv.FormatInt(accountID, 10)}}.Encode(),
+	)
+
+	const maxAttempts = 2
+	var lastErr error
+	for attempt := 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++ {
+		orgID, found, retry, err := c.doGet(ctx, endpoint)
+		if err == nil {
+			return orgID, found, nil
+		}
+		lastErr = err
+		if !retry {
+			return "", false, err
+		}
+	}
+	return "", false, lastErr
+}
+
+func (c *Client) doGet(ctx context.Context, endpoint string) (orgID string, found bool, retry bool, err error) {
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, err
+	}
+
+	timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
+	hash := calculateRequestHmac(c.secret, timestamp, http.MethodGet, endpoint, "")
+	cred := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(identity + ":" + hash + "-" + timestamp))
+	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+cred)
+	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
+
+	rsp, err := c.http.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, true, err
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = rsp.Body.Close() }()
+
+	switch {
+	case rsp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound:
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 500:
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, true, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 400:
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	}
+
+	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rsp.Body, 1<<20))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("read body: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	var orgs []organization
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &orgs); err != nil {
+		snippet := body
+		if len(snippet) > 200 {
+			snippet = snippet[:200]
+		}
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf(
+			"decode organizations: %w (status=%d content_type=%q body_snippet=%q)",
+			err, rsp.StatusCode, rsp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), snippet,
+		)
+	}
+	if len(orgs) == 0 {
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	}
+	if orgs[0].ID == "" {
+		return "", false, false, errors.New("entity-management returned organization without id")
+	}
+	return orgs[0].ID, true, false, nil

+
+// NewClient builds an entity-management client. The caller supplies an *http.Client
+// so tests (and the lambda) can inject custom transports/timeouts.
+func NewClient(baseURL, secret string, httpClient *http.Client) *Client {
+	return &Client{
+		baseURL: strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"),
+		secret:  secret,
+		http:    httpClient,

+	ID string `json:"id"`

+func (c *Client) GetOrganizationByAccount(ctx context.Context, accountID int64) (string, bool, error) {
+	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/organizations?%s",
+		c.baseURL,
+		url.Values{"account_id": []string{strconv.FormatInt(accountID, 10)}}.Encode(),
+	)
+
+	const maxAttempts = 2
+	var lastErr error
+	for attempt := 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++ {
+		orgID, found, retry, err := c.doGet(ctx, endpoint)
+		if err == nil {
+			return orgID, found, nil
+		}
+		lastErr = err
+		if !retry {
+			return "", false, err
+		}
+	}
+	return "", false, lastErr
+}

+// doGet returns retry=true if the caller should retry the request.
+func (c *Client) doGet(ctx context.Context, endpoint string) (orgID string, found bool, retry bool, err error) {
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, err
+	}
+
+	timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
+	hash := calculateRequestHmac(c.secret, timestamp, http.MethodGet, endpoint, "")
+	cred := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(identity + ":" + hash + "-" + timestamp))
+	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+cred)
+	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
+
+	rsp, err := c.http.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, true, err
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = rsp.Body.Close() }()
+
+	switch {
+	case rsp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound:
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 500:
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, true, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 400:
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	}
+
+	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rsp.Body, 1<<20))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("read body: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	var orgs []organization
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &orgs); err != nil {
+		snippet := body
+		if len(snippet) > 200 {
+			snippet = snippet[:200]
+		}
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf(
+			"decode organizations: %w (status=%d content_type=%q body_snippet=%q)",
+			err, rsp.StatusCode, rsp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), snippet,
+		)
+	}
+	if len(orgs) == 0 {
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	}
+	if orgs[0].ID == "" {
+		return "", false, false, errors.New("entity-management returned organization without id")
+	}
+	return orgs[0].ID, true, false, nil
+}

+package entitymgmt
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/base64"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+const identity = "auth"
+
+const maxResponseBytes = 1 << 20 // 1 MiB
+
+// Client signs and sends requests to accounts-mono entity-management.
+type Client struct {
+	baseURL string
+	secret  string
+	http    *http.Client
+}
+
+// NewClient builds a Client. The caller owns the *http.Client and is
+// responsible for setting a Timeout; the client is passed in (not
+// constructed here) so callers can inject a Transport for tests.
+func NewClient(baseURL, secret string, httpClient *http.Client) *Client {
+	return &Client{
+		baseURL: strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"),
+		secret:  secret,
+		http:    httpClient,
+	}
+}
+
+type organization struct {
+	ID string `json:"id"`
+}
+
+// GetOrganizationByAccount resolves a Sitoo account_id to its organization_id.
+// Returns (orgID, true, nil) on success, ("", false, nil) when no mapping
+// exists, ("", false, err) on transport, status, or decoding failures.
+// Retries once on network errors and 5xx; 404 is a clean miss; non-404
+// 4xx is a permanent failure.
+func (c *Client) GetOrganizationByAccount(ctx context.Context, accountID int64) (string, bool, error) {
+	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/organizations?%s",
+		c.baseURL,
+		url.Values{"account_id": []string{strconv.FormatInt(accountID, 10)}}.Encode(),
+	)
+
+	const maxAttempts = 2
+	var lastErr error
+	for attempt := 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++ {
+		orgID, found, retry, err := c.doGet(ctx, endpoint)
+		if err == nil {
+			return orgID, found, nil
+		}
+		lastErr = err
+		if !retry {
+			return "", false, fmt.Errorf("entity-management lookup for account_id=%d: %w", accountID, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return "", false, fmt.Errorf("entity-management lookup for account_id=%d: %w", accountID, lastErr)
+}
+
+func (c *Client) doGet(ctx context.Context, endpoint string) (orgID string, found bool, retry bool, err error) {
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, err
+	}
+
+	timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixMilli(), 10)
+	hash := calculateRequestHmac(c.secret, timestamp, http.MethodGet, endpoint, "")
+	cred := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(identity + ":" + hash + "-" + timestamp))
+	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+cred)
+	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
+
+	rsp, err := c.http.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, true, err
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = rsp.Body.Close() }()
+
+	switch {
+	case rsp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound:
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 500:
+		// drain body to enable keep-alive connection reuse
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, true, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	case rsp.StatusCode >= 400:
+		// drain body to enable keep-alive connection reuse
+		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, rsp.Body)
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("entity-management returned %d", rsp.StatusCode)
+	}
+
+	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rsp.Body, maxResponseBytes))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf("read body: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	var orgs []organization
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &orgs); err != nil {
+		snippet := body
+		if len(snippet) > 200 {
+			snippet = snippet[:200]
+		}
+		return "", false, false, fmt.Errorf(
+			"decode organizations: %w (status=%d content_type=%q body_snippet=%q)",
+			err, rsp.StatusCode, rsp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), snippet,
+		)
+	}
+	if len(orgs) == 0 {
+		return "", false, false, nil
+	}
+	if orgs[0].ID == "" {
+		return "", false, false, errors.New("entity-management returned organization without id")
+	}
+	return orgs[0].ID, true, false, nil
+}

+package entitymgmt
+
+import (
+	"crypto/hmac"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+)
+
+// calculateRequestHmac mirrors the TS implementation in
+// accounts-mono/services/entity-management/src/utils/hmac.ts.
+// HMAC-SHA256 over the concatenation timestamp || method || url || body
+// (no delimiters — adjacent fields with shifted boundaries hash identically;
+// by design, matching the upstream signing scheme).
+func calculateRequestHmac(secret, timestamp, method, url, body string) string {
+	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
+	mac.Write([]byte(timestamp))
+	mac.Write([]byte(method))
+	mac.Write([]byte(url))
+	mac.Write([]byte(body))
+	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
+}
